[Fm]He was certain,
so was I

in her sighs

[Fm]You waited, smiling, for
[C]this?

if she knew
[Db]She could take it,
I thought too Be
[Bbm]careful, be cautious, but
you just wished harder
[Fm]You waited, smiling, for
[C]this?
"But they

[Bb]love you"
Thousands and thousands of
[Dm]eyes just like mine
[C]Aching to find who they
[Bb]are
"Oh, they
[F]love you!

[Bb]love you"

[Dm]all they can do Words

[Bb]sharp

[Fm]
[Bbm]
[Fm]
[Bbm]

[Db]Make me a fairy, what-
ever it takes And
[Bbm]just like her tale, my
dream was a scam
[Fm]You waited, smiling, for
[C]this?
[Fm]I am burnt out,
I smell of smoke It
[Db]seeps through her cracks and so

[Eb]it
